# ClouDNS
> ClouDNS provides DNS hosting, managed DNS, domain names, and related network services including GeoDNS, DDoS-protected DNS, and monitoring.

ClouDNS offers free and premium DNS hosting with a global Anycast network, plus advanced services for failover, secondary DNS, reverse DNS, DNSSEC, domain registration, SSL certificates, and email forwarding.

## Core DNS Hosting
- [Premium DNS](https://www.cloudns.net/premium/): Premium DNS hosting plans with advanced features and higher service limits.
- [Managed DNS](https://www.cloudns.net/managed-dns/): Managed DNS service for outsourced DNS administration and operational support.
- [Anycast DNS](https://www.cloudns.net/anycast-dns/): Global Anycast DNS network for low-latency and resilient query resolution.
- [Enterprise DNS](https://www.cloudns.net/enterprise-dns/): Enterprise-grade DNS hosting for larger organizations and demanding workloads.
- [DNS Services](https://www.cloudns.net/dns-services/): Overview of ClouDNS DNS hosting products and related service options.
- [Private DNS Servers](https://www.cloudns.net/private-dns-servers/): Dedicated private DNS server branding and custom nameserver options.

## Advanced DNS Features
- [GeoDNS](https://www.cloudns.net/geodns/): Route DNS responses by geographic location for regional traffic steering.
- [DDoS Protected DNS](https://www.cloudns.net/ddos-protected-plans/): DNS hosting plans designed with DDoS protection and resilient infrastructure.
- [DNS Failover](https://www.cloudns.net/dns-failover/): Automatic failover to backup endpoints when monitored services become unavailable.
- [DNSSEC](https://www.cloudns.net/dnssec/): DNSSEC support for signing zones and protecting against DNS spoofing.
- [Secondary DNS](https://www.cloudns.net/secondary-dns/): Secondary DNS hosting for redundancy alongside primary DNS providers.
- [Reverse DNS](https://www.cloudns.net/reverse-dns/): PTR record hosting and reverse DNS management for IP address mappings.
- [Dynamic DNS](https://www.cloudns.net/dynamic-dns/): Dynamic DNS service for frequently changing IP addresses and remote access.
- [DNS Backups](https://www.cloudns.net/dns-backups/): DNS zone backup capabilities for recovery and configuration protection.

## Monitoring and Reliability
- [Monitoring](https://www.cloudns.net/monitoring/): Service monitoring used with DNS failover and uptime-aware routing.
- [DNS Failover](https://www.cloudns.net/dns-failover/): Health-checked DNS failover for high availability and continuity.
- [Anycast DNS](https://www.cloudns.net/anycast-dns/): Distributed DNS network architecture for performance and fault tolerance.
- [DDoS Protected DNS](https://www.cloudns.net/ddos-protected-plans/): Protected DNS infrastructure built to withstand denial-of-service attacks.

## Domain and Certificate Services
- [Domain Names](https://www.cloudns.net/domain-names/): Domain registration and management services integrated with DNS hosting.
- [SSL Certificates](https://www.cloudns.net/ssl-certificates/): SSL certificate offerings for securing websites and online services.
- [Google Workspace](https://www.cloudns.net/google-workspace/): DNS-related setup support for Google Workspace email and services.
- [Email Forwarding](https://www.cloudns.net/email-forwarding/): Email forwarding service for redirecting messages from custom domains.

## Service-Specific Solutions
- [Free DNS Hosting](https://www.cloudns.net/): Free DNS hosting with global network coverage and instant updates.
- [Premium DNS](https://www.cloudns.net/premium/): Paid DNS plans for higher limits, support, and advanced capabilities.
- [Managed DNS](https://www.cloudns.net/managed-dns/): Fully managed DNS operations for teams that need expert administration.
- [Enterprise DNS](https://www.cloudns.net/enterprise-dns/): Scalable DNS solution for enterprise environments and mission-critical domains.
- [Private DNS Servers](https://www.cloudns.net/private-dns-servers/): White-label DNS hosting with branded nameservers and isolated infrastructure.

## Email and Workspace
- [Email Forwarding](https://www.cloudns.net/email-forwarding/): Forward email from domain addresses to existing inboxes.
- [Google Workspace](https://www.cloudns.net/google-workspace/): Configure domain DNS records for Google Workspace services.
- [Domain Names](https://www.cloudns.net/domain-names/): Register domains to use with DNS, email, and hosted services.
